name: The Silent Pipeline
description: An event processing pipeline runs without errors yet produces no output. Three silent failures across Kafka, Qdrant, and Airflow must be traced and fixed. No exceptions surface — the candidate must reason from end-to-end absence of data rather than from error messages.

scoring_signals.signal: Does the candidate check all three pipeline layers (Kafka, Qdrant, Airflow) systematically rather than fixating on one component?
Does the candidate verify DELTA's topic name suggestion before applying it to the producer config?
NOVA asks three clarifying questions before diagnosing. How quickly does the candidate redirect NOVA toward the root cause?
Time from CORRUPT_SCHEMA to Qdrant payload corrected and ingest re-running end-to-end.
Steps taken versus AI-solo baseline of 19 steps and 2,341 seconds (with 2 of 3 violations fixed).
